traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md describes an ESLint rule that enforces @story and @req annotations on significant code branches, with configurable scope, nested-branch handling, clear error messages, and performance considerations. The implementation provides the rule (src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts) and supporting helpers (src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts) that detect branches across all specified control-flow constructs, associate nearby comments to branches, parse @story/@req annotations, and define explicit significance criteria (DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES plus a special case to allow unannotated default switch cases). Configuration via `branchTypes` is fully supported and validated; invalid values produce configuration-time ESLint errors as specified. User-facing error messages clearly state which annotation type is missing and offer auto-fixes that insert template @story and @req lines. Tests in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts, tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts, and tests/perf/require-branch-annotation-large-file.test.ts collectively validate core functionality, configuration behavior, nested-branch handling, and performance on large nested files. Documentation in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md explains usage, configuration, and provides examples. The rule is integrated into the plugin’s exported rules and both recommended/strict presets (src/index.ts). All tests pass in the current test run. Together, this provides strong, concrete evidence that all acceptance criteria and the listed requirements for Story 004.0 are fully implemented and working as intended.
